senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.), pl. כְּבָלִים, כְּבָלִין foot-chains, irons.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91">Gen. R. s. 91</cite> <he>ליתן עליהם כ׳</he> to put them in chains. Tanḥ. Thazr. 8, v. <cite ref="K00060"><he>כָּבַל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 4">Deut. R. s. 4</cite> <he>כ׳ של ברזל</he> iron chains, opp. <he>מונייק של זהב</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 2:4">Tosef. Ab. Zar. II, 4</cite> <he>אין מוכרין … ולא כ׳</he> (ed. Zuck. <cite ref="K00189"><he>כּוֹבְלִין</he></cite>) we must not sell them torturing blocks or irons.—
Sabb. VI, 4 כ׳ טמאין וכ׳ a woman’s ankle-chains are fit for levitical uncleanness &c. (contrad. to בירית). Y. ib. VI, 8ᵇ, v. בֵּירִית; Bab.
<cite ref="Shabbat 63b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>עשו להן כ׳ וכ׳</he> they made for them ankle-bands and put a chain between, that their steps may not be wide; a. e.
